verdict.rationale: Jira is a work-tracking and project-management product, not an AI coding agent. Restoring an agent session to a prior checkpoint is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Jira shipping a coding agent with session version history: Rovo AI is described only for automations, task breakdown and trend surfacing, and sandboxes are admin test environments, not agent checkpoints.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
